target: acceptance 1 — diff size is captured at the point a diff exists, via an explicit emit from the review stage
cmd:
mkdir -p .agentic; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; git init -q .; git config user.email a@b; git config user.name a; printf "one
" > f.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm base; b=$(git rev-parse HEAD); printf "one
two
three
" > f.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm change; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" diff-size --base "$b" --head HEAD </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
